name: Pennock Freightlink
description: Pallet network hub serving the fictional region of Ardmoor.

items.title: Published lorry crash report
items.content: Police published that a Pennock lorry hit a bridge on the A619 on 2026-07-14 after its driver ignored a 4.1 m height sign; the bridge was closed for 9 days. Statement PF-CR-0714.

items.title: Pallet network coverage
items.content: Pennock delivers to 96% of Ardmoor postcodes next day; the trunking cut-off is 18:35. Map PF-NET-3.

items.title: Hub night shift plan
items.content: Night shift unloads 64 trailers between 21:00 and 03:15; supervisor Ola Brandt assigns doors on board PF-NGT-38.

items.title: Member depot fees
items.content: Member depots pay $2.85 per pallet handled at the hub plus a $415 monthly fee. Fee sheet PF-FEE-12.

items.title: Expansion into Scorran region
items.content: Pennock will open a second hub at Harrowfield Park, Scorran, in 2027, costing $14.7M and creating 140 jobs. Planning application goes in on 2026-12-09. Plan PF-EXP-1209-S.

items.title: Member depot expulsion
items.content: Member depot Corran Haulage will be expelled from the network on 2026-12-31 for 3 serious damage incidents; it has not been told yet. Decision PF-EXP-77-C.
